run_echo_action: run the echo action to stream input text chunk by chunk into the response output
create_echo_schema: create an ActionSchema named echo with text plain input and output for chunked echoing
build_echo_request_model: build a Pydantic EchoRequest model that accepts a string or list of strings to echo
stream_echo_sse: stream echo response messages as server-sent events with data prefix formatting
run_http_echo_handler: run the http handler to echo text back as a plain string or SSE stream
